documents.title: Project answer
documents.question:
Tell us about a technical system or project you built, configured, automated or troubleshot. This could be a personal project, home lab, university assignment, hackathon or team project, involving hardware, software, networks or cloud services.

In your response, briefly explain:
- What you were trying to achieve.
- The main components or technologies you used.
- One technical decision you made and why.
- One problem you encountered, how you investigated it and what you learned.
- Your individual contribution, if you worked as part of a team.

(Max 300 words)
